title: Delayed Free Recall of Word Lists
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial EEG recordings from a delayed free recall task in which participants studied visually presented word lists, solved arithmetic distractor problems, and then freely recalled the words. Data were collected at multiple clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania. Monopolar and bipolar recordings are provided with subject-specific electrode montages, MNI/Talairach coordinates, and brain region annotations.
methods_description: Participants viewed word lists one at a time, completed simple arithmetic problems as a distractor, then freely recalled the words in any order. Intracranial recordings were acquired on multiple systems and rescaled so all voltages are in volts. Monopolar recordings are referenced (typically to a mastoid) and should be re-referenced before analysis, while bipolar recordings follow a paired scheme.
